verdict.rationale: Make stores connections as team-scoped entities: the API lists all connections for a team ID, so credentials are held centrally and shared at the team level. A per-connection access list (entity ACL) lets admins grant principals a role on a specific connection, which covers controlling who can use which credential. missing for 10: detail on the available roles and what each permits, UI and help-center documentation of the sharing workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
